notes: Fixed: the database server (dab-phr) failing to start, or dropping out mid-run, so a run that needed row data quietly did without it. Across the logs on one machine only 21% of its starts succeeded — 212 of 350 timed out. Cause: it is a .NET program and resolves the SQL host through the same call that reported the host unreachable while the VPN was up. Given a name it cannot resolve it churns for 38 seconds and dies; given the address it is ready in under 4. The app now resolves the host itself and hands over the address, and refuses to do so where the name is genuinely needed (a validated certificate, or integrated security).

Also raised the time a database server is given to start, from 30 seconds to 90. Of the starts that did work, the median was 15 seconds and the slowest 30.3 — the old limit was sitting right on top of them.

Fixed: "Allow <tool> and continue" said Resuming and then nothing happened; Pause and Resume was the only way on. The tool list is fixed when the agent starts, so a running agent could never see the new one. The button restarts the session with it now.
Fixed: closing the app on a question and pressing Continue lost the question and carried on without you — including when the run had stopped as blocked, which the first version of that fix got wrong.
Fixed: "the host is unreachable, schema only until the VPN is up" while the VPN was up and SSMS was connected.
A chat can now be opened on a folder where a fix is developing — read-only — instead of being refused, and no longer surveys the repository before being asked anything.
New: Minimize on any card that asks you something, and the DBA's two SQL standards built in. The agent no longer writes comments into the code it changes.
Also carries 2.14.0: the 2.13.0 start-screen fix, and your real plan usage (the /usage figure) in the strip.
